metadata.spin_provenance: Nominal low-spin occupation assumption; not a determined ground spin. GFN2-xTB is not a spin-state discriminating model.
metadata.proton_site_chemistry: hydroxypyridine O-H/O-; benzylic C-H is a second unscanned responsive site
metadata.embedding_status: ETKDG constrained embedding succeeded on attempt 1; organic UFF preparation only
metadata.structure_status: Designed starting geometry; requires electronic optimization and coordination-retention validation
metadata.literature_identity: Scaffold-informed designed analogue; exact metal/R/ancillary combination is not asserted published
metadata.transformations: hydrogenated = active + H2 (one ligand proton and one metal hydride); protonated_reference = active + H+ (charge +1)
metadata.energy_comparison_scope: States of different stoichiometry/charge require explicit H2/proton/electron chemical-potential references

ligand_connectivity.criterion: 1.28 times ASE covalent-radius sum, excluding K coordination

standard_state: ALPB gsolv excess contribution plus ideal 1 atm to 1 M correction once
hessian_method: Native full unbiased numerical xTB --hess; unprojected hessian.out mass weighted and projected
